newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: SOCCER-SOUTH AFRICA SUPERSPORT SERIES SCORES.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-SOUTH AFRICA SUPERSPORT SERIES SCORES.

text.p: Close of play scores in four-day Supersport Series cricket matches on Sunday:
In Durban (day three): Natal 282 and 349-7 declared (Derek Crookes 52, Jonty Rhodes 156 not out), Free State 160 and 68-0.

In Port Elizabeth (day three): Western Province 401-2 declared and 165-2 (Jacques Kallis 71 not out, H.D.Ackerman 59 not out), Eastern Province 300-9 declared (Louis Koen 128, Mark Rushmere 74; Meyrick Pringle 4-79).
